name: Breadth-First Search and Unweighted Shortest Paths
problem_statement: Compute minimum hop distances and optional predecessor paths from one or more source vertices.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

problem_inputs.name: sources
problem_inputs.description: Nonempty set of distinct source vertices.

problem_inputs.name: source_mode
problem_inputs.description: Independent searches return one result per source; nearest_source returns distance to the closest source.

problem_inputs.name: depth_limit
problem_inputs.description: Null means unlimited; otherwise a nonnegative hop limit.

problem_inputs.name: return_predecessors
problem_inputs.description: Return a predecessor forest for reconstructing shortest paths.

required_outputs.name: distances
required_outputs.description: Source-indexed or nearest-source hop distances; null denotes unreachable within the cutoff.

required_outputs.name: complete
required_outputs.description: True when all vertices within the requested depth were processed.

optional_outputs.name: predecessors
optional_outputs.description: One valid predecessor per reachable nonsource vertex.

solution_semantics.objective: Minimize edge count along each requested source-to-vertex path.
solution_semantics.exactness: Distances are exact within the declared cutoff. A predecessor may be any valid shortest-path predecessor.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Compare hop distances against CPU BFS on small fixtures.
Each reachable nonsource predecessor has an edge to its vertex and distance exactly one less.
edge_cases: An isolated source has distance zero.
A zero depth limit returns only sources.

correctness: Compare hop distances against CPU BFS on small fixtures.
Each reachable nonsource predecessor has an edge to its vertex and distance exactly one less.
